MediaDrop bundles the following third-party software. Each remains under its own license.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
Electron (https://www.electronjs.org) — MIT License
Includes Chromium and Node.js; their licenses are in LICENSE and
LICENSES.chromium.html inside MediaDrop.app/Contents/Frameworks.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
yt-dlp (https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp) — The Unlicense (public domain)
Files: MediaDrop.app/Contents/Resources/yt-dlp (official yt-dlp_macos.zip build, which
includes Python and other libraries; their licenses are in _internal/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt)
MediaDrop installs newer official releases in ~/Library/Application Support/MediaDrop/yt-dlp.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
FFmpeg (https://ffmpeg.org) — GNU General Public License v3 (GPLv3)
Files: MediaDrop.app/Contents/Resources/bin/ffmpeg, ffprobe (version 9.0.2)
This is an unmodified static build by Martin Riedl (https://ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de),
configured with --enable-gpl --enable-version3 (includes x264, x265 and others).

Corresponding source code:
  FFmpeg 9.0.2 source:  https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz
  Build scripts and library sources used for this build:
                        https://git.martin-riedl.de/ffmpeg/build-script
If those links are unavailable, contact the MediaDrop author for a copy of the
source code, which will be provided for at least three years from distribution.

GPLv3 full text: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt
